narrative.question:
Can we pull HRA datasets/knowledge via the live CCF API (reference organs,
cell-type terms, anatomical-structure terms) and link BioModels to HRA
anatomy (Uberon organs) via a transparent biomodel Digital Object +
organ->models index — and, having built that index, actually get the
resulting models onto the HRA atlas as something a user can see?

decisions.title: Resolved: SBML MIRIAM/BTO annotation matching (annotation-organ-matching, annotation-recall-gain) raised full-corpus recall from 82/1,096 (7.5%) to a 167/1,096 (15.2%) union across 14 organs. Should the union (not name-only) become the default organ->models index the Atlas Browser and downstream coverage studies key off?
decisions.detail: annotation-recall-gain's fp-union-organ-index followup proposes re-running model-coverage-3d/corpus-coverage against the union index; the Atlas Browser currently renders whatever organ->models index is passed to it, so this is a live wiring decision, not just an analysis one.

decisions.title: How much more organ coverage would extending the 32-entry BTO->organ crosswalk unlock?
decisions.detail: 278 corpus models carry a BTO term at all, but only 114 resolve to an organ through the current crosswalk (annotation-organ-matching's fp-bto-crosswalk-extension followup) — 985/1,096 models (89.9%) remain untagged by either matcher combined.
